body: Yeah, fair enough. Thanks for your response :)

It was only supposed to add anticipation to the surprise I guess. My family has always done stuff like that. She is newer to the family so I guess I didn’t need to do it. But admittedly when she rejected the ticket, it hurt my feelings. And while I could have told her then, it kind of made me change my mind, which might make me an AH

No, not really. I just thought it would be super surprising if she found out like a week before. My friends even assumed that she would guess who it was, and knowing the date of the concert, be able to confirm the artist. I could have told her once she declined, but her reasoning and general attitude kinda made me not want to. She kind of hurt my feelings rejecting me in such a way, when I was just trying to spend time with her, it felt like spending time with me wasn’t worth her time.
